paper_title: Measurement of light-by-light scattering and search for axion-like particles with 2.2 nb$^{-1}$ of Pb+Pb data with the ATLAS detector
notes: ATLAS light-by-light scattering search for ALPs in Pb+Pb UPC, masses 6-100 GeV. Coupling reported as 1/Lambda_a ranging from 0.3 TeV^-1 (=3e-4 GeV^-1) at low mass to 0.06 TeV^-1 (=6e-5 GeV^-1). Data points are approximate readings from text statements; precise per-mass values are in Figure 9/HepData which are not fully tabulated in text. Mass converted from GeV to eV. This is a collider/UPC bound, not a haloscope, so no DM density.
